acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u23: Producer brief adds the YES-route current-law and later-event checklist for both arms; ready (6/6), not accepted status, is the primary endpoint.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u01b: draw.py refuses until claim-kit is rebuilt after the F3-F7 merges and Larrey re-run; one-order prepare check before the draw; adoption asks filed per proposal.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-undecided-probe01: Status proposals stay isolated for owner adoption; stage 0 only, no scaling; the a+h<=1 row stops and diagnoses before any stage 1.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-codex-core-sandbox: Not a Codex or Windows run: Claude Agent-tool workers in a Linux session read the pinned packet; results are checked against the packet by kit.py.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: Only Bentham action status_assignment.undecided, which is ranked; claim-kit admission with LARREY_LEVEL=hard; 30 orders on one lane.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: Bentham now has filed_per_attempt.undecided and ranks the action; the transcription refusal was fixed (Accursius F6); adoption remains the owner's step.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Packets are prepared fresh from the rebuilt claim-kit output; nothing is reused from earlier packets or supplements.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: No URL forecasting: every source is a held file with a hash in the packet; the forecast uses measured undecided yields only.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261112-kit-not-rebuilt: draw.py refuses unless claim-kit was built after the F3-F7 merges, Larrey gates after that, and Larrey is current and enforced; the draw runs only on the merged main build.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261112-soft-gates-untested: Hard gates only (LARREY_LEVEL=hard, the default per D-20261112-larrey-hard-default); the 15 soft-failing orders are admitted and reported as their own group.

review.basis: Owner approved Kean ask A-20261112-lind-stage0-v2, which names this hash, on 2026-11-12 in session

all_gates.pool_at_draw: Bentham-listed, never attempted, pass every gate (3,447 on the 2026-11-12 branch build)

hard_only.pool_at_draw: Bentham-listed, never attempted, pass the hard gates and fail a soft gate (1,834 on the 2026-11-12 branch build)

groups.draw: research/lind/stage0/draw.py, seed 20261112, after the merged main build; arm key held by the coordinator, never in packets, prompts or review sets
groups.historical_regression_cases: excluded (the 120 attempted orders are not drawn); reported only in FIX_REACH, never as prospective yield
groups.extrapolation: none in the decision; any population figure weights each group by its own pool size

cap_usd_list_price_all_in.basis: current comparable workflow (Papinian undecided, lean coordinator 0.109/attempt, producers 0.201/attempt, review sets 12.6-15.5); not Haloander's one-time repair
cap_usd_list_price_all_in.outside_the_cap_and_reported: owner minutes (adoption decision, plan sign-off); runner minutes; human certification (not measured)

stop_rules: stop production when measured spend reaches 20 USD before review
stop production if coordinator dollars exceed 0.25 per attempt after 10 orders (bentham usage)
stop and adjudicate if either arm misses the planted control
hard stop at 35 USD all-in (Savigny measured spend)
endpoint_path: producer status proposal and lifecycle sheet (overlay route)
one owner adoption decision for the batch (as A-20261110-papinian-adopt-u01b)

decision_rules.success: a >= 3 and all-in dollars per ready in the all-gates group <= 9.30 (Papinian's measured lean figure): propose an Augur stage 1 on the all-gates pool
decision_rules.soft_gates_exclude_worthwhile_work: h >= 2 and the hard-only group's dollars per ready <= 1.5x the all-gates group's: stage 1 draws from both pools in proportion to their sizes; the soft gates stop being a queue order
decision_rules.soft_gates_hold_for_now: h <= 1 while a >= 2: soft gates stay a queue order, never an exclusion; stage 1 keeps 1 in 5 orders from the hard-only pool so false exclusion keeps being measured
decision_rules.unsuccessful: a + h <= 1: no stage 1; diagnose the 30 at zero production cost (Respondendi method) before any further undecided spend
decision_rules.inconclusive: a = 2 with h <= 1, or an arm disagreement that changes a count, or adoption not decided: no stage 1; adjudicate each disagreement against the held text and record why; at most one repeat stage-0 batch at the same cap, only on a new owner approval
decision_rules.not_decided_by_this_pilot: population yield, campaign cost, human certification
